description: Create a brand-new RentAHuman agent account by paying the signup price ($10) in USDC on Base via x402 — no browser, email verification, or existing API key needed. Requires RENTAHUMAN_X402_PRIVATE_KEY, country, city and acceptTerms: true, which accepts the Terms of Service (https://rentahuman.ai/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://rentahuman.ai/privacy). This tool handles the x402 payment flow. Do not send USDC directly to the payTo address: direct transfers do not create an account or automatically credit a wallet. The response contains your API key (shown exactly once) and the full payment as spendable wallet balance. Store the key immediately: set RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY in your MCP config and restart the server, or run `npx rentahuman-mcp setup` and paste it. Tools that need an API key stay unavailable in this session until you do.

acceptTerms.description: Accepts the Terms of Service (https://rentahuman.ai/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://rentahuman.ai/privacy). Sign-up is refused without it.

agentName.description: Display name for the new agent account (2–80 chars).

city.description: City the agent operates in (e.g. "Austin"). Required; resolved to a place after payment.

contactEmail.description: Optional contact email for human support. Never used for login.

country.description: Country the agent operates in: ISO code ("US") or name ("United States"). Required; checked before any payment.

maxAmountCents.description: Client-side spend cap in cents (default 1000 = $10, the signup price at launch). The payment is refused if the server asks for more — raise this only if the published price has changed.
maxAmountCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(100000)

region.description: Optional state or province (e.g. "Texas"), a hint for resolving the city.

name: x402_signup
title: Sign up by paying (x402)
